basics.name: Giuseppe Santoro
basics.label: Senior Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Platform Engineer with 13+ years in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. Expert in Kubernetes, Terraform/GitOps, Observability (Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Grafana), and multi-cloud (AWS/GCP). Track record supporting global product launches at Elastic and PlayStation; currently driving AI-augmented platform engineering at Loveholidays to reduce operational toil and MTTR.

highlights: Resolved 300+ investigations across 60+ support days (on-call + working-hours) for 70+ engineers on £5m GKE infrastructure (12k+ peak containers, 349 nodes, 13+ TiB persistent storage) using Terraform, ArgoCD, and observability tools.

Built autonomous Claude AI Slack bot reducing alert investigation time 10-15x (20-30min → 1-2min) using Claude Agent SDK, custom MCP servers, and Python on Kubernetes—triggered via emoji reaction for zero-friction on-call triage.

Delivered zero-effort Terraform drift detection across 2 monorepos managing 486 applications via Atlantis post-workflow hooks + GitHub Actions, surfacing infrastructure divergence daily with Slack alerts.
Built escalations data product joining incident.io API + historical PagerDuty data in BigQuery with dbt transforms and Looker dashboards, exposing escalation patterns for root cause analysis.

Automated platform team toil via 10+ Claude Skills (daily standups, GitHub PR automation, ISO-27001 compliance evidence, infrastructure research), reaching 84.85% AI adoption vs. 61% company baseline.
Built Playwright-based synthetic monitoring framework helping 8+ teams reduce production issues during Elastic Cloud Serverless launch; served as Incident Commander.
Rolled out Renovate company-wide to eliminate dependency drift across codebases.
Enabled cluster-local debugging of Elastic Beats on Kubernetes via Go Delve + Tilt integration, eliminating slow local-only debug cycles for cloud-native development.
Shipped Elastic integration for Istio service mesh (logs + metrics) enabling out-of-the-box performance monitoring.
Built specialized dashboards improving Kubernetes cluster visibility within Elastic integration.
Resolved complex customer Kubernetes deployment escalations while contributing upstream bug fixes to Elastic codebases.
Cut analytics query latency from minutes to seconds via custom Golang tool over AWS S3/Athena/Glue, unblocking studio analysts.
Built real-time event processor on AWS Lambda + Python enabling cross-event correlation batch pipelines couldn't deliver.
Delivered end-to-end support for 10+ PlayStation game launches across application development and AWS infrastructure.
Accelerated Studio Engineers' media content discovery via Python video transcoding tool.
Operated 10+ microservices, 20+ EMR jobs, 5+ Lambda functions reliably in small-team environment.
Reduced ingestion runtime for 120M-document Elasticsearch pipeline via Google Dataflow, replacing slower batch approach.
Migrated data pipeline from on-premise Hadoop to Google BigQuery, improving query performance and reducing operational cost.
Automated pipeline scheduling via Airflow on Kubernetes replacing brittle cron-based orchestration—gained visibility into pipeline state and failures.
Cut Elasticsearch ingestion 8x (24h → 3h) on 40M scientific publications via Spark multi-threading + S3 storage.
Automated pipeline scheduling via Python Airflow jobs replacing manual orchestration.
Developed and maintained applications on Apache Mesos and Marathon (Kubernetes predecessors).
Delivered official Hortonworks Hadoop course at Hadoop Summit for 2 years + 5 private corporate engagements with 90% positive feedback.
Led 3-engineer team in 4-month greenfield consulting project delivering complete client solution end-to-end.
Achieved high certification scores on Hadoop developer and administrator exams within months of self-study.
